decisions.decision: Fixture normalization must be verified across process restarts
decisions.rationale: HashMap iteration order is stable within a process, so EnumProvider's order instability was invisible to a same-process determinism check that had reported 'zero undeclared volatility'

decisions.decision: Only the default provider must resolve for the current OS in validate()
decisions.rationale: Multi-platform configs legitimately omit OSes (FishMan is Windows-only in config/skf.yaml)

decisions.decision: Assert the real behaviour of expand_env_vars rather than an idealised one
decisions.rationale: The function was moved verbatim; 'a%%b' really does produce 'a%b', and idealising the test would have been a silent behaviour change

decisions.decision: EnumProvider.result uses the <unordered> marker rather than full volatility
decisions.rationale: Declaring the whole array volatile would erase the assertion on which providers are returned

next_action: Run /gsd-execute-phase 1, which will skip 01-01 and 01-02 (both have SUMMARY.md) and start wave 3 at plan 01-03 task 01-03-01 (define the SkfProvider trait and handle/error types in src/provider/mod.rs).
context_notes: Wave 2 ended with behaviour preservation proven: three fresh server processes each reproduced all 37 committed fixtures under oracle normalization. The provider work in wave 3 is pure addition (src/provider/{mod,native,fake}.rs) and is NOT wired into production dispatch — that is deliberate per decision D-06; only four self-contained branches (EnumDevice, GetDevState, WaitForDevEvent, CancelWaitForDevEvent) get routed in wave 4. Wave 3's central constraints: NativeSkfProvider must hold exactly one Arc<Library> (the pre-refactor code reloaded the library on ten call paths), the trait must not expose HANDLE or *mut c_void, and no second unsafe impl Send/Sync may appear. Wave 4 must preserve the three default bind addresses exactly (127.0.0.1:9001, 0.0.0.0:8000 console, 127.0.0.1:8000 service) and expose the resolved local_addr so the ephemeral-port replay test can connect.
